candidate.answerReason: February 6 is one week before Friday the 13th. February 1 is five days before that Friday, so it is Sunday.

methods.label: Go back one week, then five days
methods.explanation: Weekdays repeat every seven days, so February \(13-7=6\) was also a Friday. February \(1\) is five days before February \(6\). Counting backward from Friday gives Thursday, Wednesday, Tuesday, Monday, Sunday. Therefore February \(1\) was \(\boxed{\text{Sunday}}\), choice \(\text{A}\).
methods.levelReason: Uses the seven-day week and elementary backward counting, without formal congruence notation.
